texts/city-names.md.camranh: The anchorage the force for Borneo sailed from in December 1941, and the western invasion force for Java in February 1942.
texts/city-names.md.jambi: A river port on the Batang Hari north of Palembang, shipping the oil and rubber of its own field.
texts/city-names.md.kupang: Dutch Timor's capital, taken on 20 February 1942 with a parachute landing behind the Australian force, which surrendered three days later.
texts/city-names.md.kendari: The airfield taken on 24 January 1942 against almost no resistance, wanted for its position and the quality of its works. Darwin was bombed from it on 19 February.
texts/city-names.md.denpasar: The southern Balinese court town, where the Dutch broke the kingdom of Badung in 1906 and its royal house died in a mass suicide.
texts/city-names.md.davao: Taken on 20 December 1941, and before the war the largest Japanese community in Southeast Asia — some twenty thousand people growing abaca.

texts/sites/sites.md.leyte: Four separate actions over four days in October 1944, and the largest naval battle of the war. It destroyed the Imperial Navy as a fighting force and saw the first organised kamikaze attacks.
